request-settings.json.description: Evolve this exact character to tier 3. Blue perch elite lancer. Transform into a compact deep-blue armored fish champion: thick silver-edged scale plates, swept fin crest helmet exposing eye and fish snout, reinforced boots, imposing trident-like blue crystal lance. Clearly stronger body silhouette than tier2. Preserve crisp pixel style, original facing and palette. No cape, text, background or extra limbs. Full body, no clipping.
